name: Dynamic Warm-Up Circuit
description: Players move baseline to half court and back through a sequence: light jog, high knees, butt kicks, side shuffle both ways, carioca, backwards jog, walking lunges, skips for height, then 2 progressive accelerations.
coaching_points: Quality over speed; land softly; arms active; keep shoulders square on shuffle.
easier: Shorten to 4 movements and walk back between reps.
harder: Add a ball: dribble with the weak hand while doing the movements.

name: Ball Tag Warm-Up
description: Everyone dribbles inside the half court. 2 taggers (without ball) try to tag dribblers; tagged players freeze with a wide stance until a teammate dribbles through their legs to free them. Rotate taggers every 60 seconds.
coaching_points: Eyes up; protect the ball with the off arm; change speed to escape.
easier: Taggers walk; use the whole court.
harder: Dribblers must use the weak hand only; taggers can steal the ball instead of tagging.

name: Line Weave Warm-Up
description: Three lines on the baseline. Middle player passes to a wing, cuts behind, receives from the other wing, continuous 3-player weave full court; finish with a lay-up, jog back on the sidelines.
coaching_points: Lead the receiver with the pass; hands ready as a target; sprint after the pass.
easier: Half court only, walking pace, no shot.
harder: Two balls in a weave; or finish with a jump stop and pull-up jumper.

name: Mirror Warm-Up
description: Pairs face each other on a line. One leads with slow movements (shuffles, jumps, touches on the floor, turns), the partner mirrors. Switch leader every 45 seconds, then add speed.
coaching_points: Stay low in athletic stance; react with the whole body; quiet feet.
harder: Leader may add a jab step or a fake; follower must react within one step.

name: Two-Ball Warm-Up Lines
description: Full court in waves of 4: two-ball dribbling variations (same time, alternate, high-low, one high one low), walk back tossing one ball hand to hand.
coaching_points: Bounce the balls hard and with the fingertips; eyes on the far basket.
easier: One ball only, working on the weak hand.
harder: Add a change of pace on every free-throw line extended.

name: Follow the Leader Dribble
description: Groups of 4-5 in a line, each with a ball. The leader dribbles around the gym choosing the path and the move (crossover, spin, behind the back); the group copies. Change leader on the whistle.
coaching_points: Head up; use both hands; keep the dribble low when changing direction.
harder: Leader adds a stop and a pivot on each cone.

name: Rope-less Jump Rope and Foot Fire
description: On the spot: 30s foot fire (fast small steps), 30s imaginary jump rope, 30s split jumps, 30s star jumps, repeat with a light jog lap in between.
coaching_points: Stay on the toes; quick contacts with the floor; breathe.
harder: Add a partner who calls a direction to sprint 3 steps on the whistle.

name: Partner Passing Jog
description: Pairs jog side by side down the court exchanging chest passes, back with bounce passes, then overhead passes, then one-hand push passes, keeping 3 metres apart.
coaching_points: Step to the pass; thumbs down on the follow-through; catch with the hands, see the ball.
harder: Add a defender jogging between the two who tries to touch the pass.

name: Cone Reaction Warm-Up
description: Four coloured cones around each player at 2 metres. Players jog on the spot; the coach calls a colour and the player sprints to touch it and returns to athletic stance. Add two colours in sequence.
coaching_points: First step explosive; low hips when touching the cone; recover quickly.
harder: Coach shows the colour instead of calling it; add a ball to dribble.

name: Basket Circuit Warm-Up
description: Two lines at half court. Player 1 dribbles in for a lay-up, rebounds, passes to the next in the other line, who shoots a short jumper; rotate lines. 4 minutes each side.
coaching_points: Take-off on the correct foot; soft touch on the backboard; catch, square, shoot.
easier: Walk into the lay-up from the free-throw line.
harder: Reverse lay-ups and floaters; Euro step.

name: Animal Walks
description: Baseline to free-throw line and back: bear crawl, crab walk, frog jumps, inchworm, bunny hops, then 2 sprints.
coaching_points: Keep the core tight; full range of movement; land on the whole foot.
harder: Add a ball to roll with the hands during the bear crawl.

name: Zig-Zag Dribble Warm-Up
description: Cones in a zig-zag full court. Dribble to each cone and change direction with a crossover, then a spin, then a behind the back, then a between the legs on each pass.
coaching_points: Change of direction with the outside foot; protect with the body; accelerate out of the move.
harder: Two balls; or a defender trailing with a hand up.

name: Agility Ladder Series
description: Ladder patterns: one foot per square, two feet per square, lateral two-in, icky shuffle, hopscotch, in-in-out-out. Sprint 5 m after each pass.
coaching_points: Stay on the toes; arms drive; look ahead not at the feet.
harder: Add a ball: dribble while doing the pattern; or catch a pass at the exit.

name: Jump and Land Progression
description: Teach landing: two-foot jump and stick, single-leg hop and stick, jump over a cone and stick, jump and 90 degree turn, jump and catch a pass in the air then land.
coaching_points: Knees over toes, hips back, chest up on landing; hold the landing for 2 seconds; silent feet.
easier: Lower jump height; hold on to a partner for balance.
harder: Land and immediately react to a call (sprint left or right).

name: Balance and Single-Leg Stations
description: Single-leg stand 20s each side; single-leg stand while passing a ball around the body; single-leg stand with eyes closed; single-leg reach to touch the floor and return; single-leg while a partner passes a ball.
coaching_points: Hip stable, knee soft; core tight; look at a fixed point.
easier: Touch the toe of the free leg to the floor when needed.
harder: Stand on a folded mat or cushion; partner pushes lightly.

name: Reaction Ball Drop
description: Partner holds a ball at shoulder height, 3 metres away. Drops it; the player in athletic stance must catch it after one bounce. Progress: catch before it bounces twice at a greater distance, react to a call of left or right hand.
coaching_points: Athletic stance ready; explode with the first step; catch with two hands.
harder: Partner holds two balls and drops one; player faces away and reacts to the sound.

name: Juggling and Ball Toss Coordination
description: Toss and catch with one hand, clap between; toss behind the back and catch in front; toss under the leg; with two balls, toss one and dribble the other; partner juggling passes with two balls.
coaching_points: Soft hands; eyes on the ball; rhythm before speed.
easier: Use a smaller ball or tennis ball.
harder: Two tennis balls and one basketball at once; rhythm changes on the whistle.

name: Footwork Square
description: Square of 4 cones (3 m sides). Player: sprint forward, shuffle right, backpedal, shuffle left. Then with turns: drop step, hip turn. Then coach points and player changes direction.
coaching_points: Never cross the feet on the shuffle; low hips; chest up on the backpedal.
harder: Add a ball; add a partner giving a pass at each corner.

name: Sprint and Deceleration
description: Sprint 10 m then stop in 2 steps at the cone with a jump stop; sprint 10 m stop with a stride stop; sprint and stop on the whistle; sprint, stop, change direction.
coaching_points: Decelerate with the hips low; feet wide; head over the base.
harder: Add a defender sprinting alongside; race to a loose ball.

name: Hurdle Hops and Bounds
description: Two-foot hops over 5 mini hurdles; single-leg hops; lateral hops; bounding (long alternate leg jumps) 15 m; finish with a jump to touch the net or backboard.
coaching_points: Land quietly; minimal ground contact time; use arms.
easier: Cones instead of hurdles; walk between reps.
harder: Hops then immediate sprint 5 m; or hop, land, and catch a pass.

name: Core Circuit
description: 30s each: plank, side plank each side, dead bug, glute bridge, bird dog, superman hold. Two rounds for older groups.
coaching_points: Neutral spine; breathe; quality reps.
harder: Add ball passes with a partner during the plank.

name: Rhythm and Jumping Jacks Coordination
description: Cross-body coordination: jumping jacks, cross jacks (arms and legs cross), seal jacks, then hand-foot patterns (clap when feet apart), then dribble with a rhythm called by the coach (bounce-bounce-clap).
coaching_points: Rhythm first; keep counting aloud; laugh when it goes wrong and try again.
easier: Slow tempo, one movement at a time.
harder: Coach changes the pattern every 4 counts.

name: Speed Ladder Mirror Race
description: Two ladders side by side. Two players race through the same pattern, then sprint to touch the half-court line and back. Winner stays on.
coaching_points: Fast feet, but a wrong pattern means restart.
harder: Add a ball pick-up and lay-up at the end of the sprint.

name: Jump Stop and Pivot Footwork
description: Toss, catch with a jump stop, front pivot, reverse pivot; then 1-2 stop (stride stop) on either foot; then receive a pass and pivot to face the basket.
coaching_points: Land balanced, knees bent; pivot on the ball of the foot; protect the ball with the elbows out.
harder: Pivot against a live defender who shadows.

name: Relay Races with Skills
description: Teams of 3-4. Relay full court: dribble down and pass back, then dribble with the weak hand, then dribble and shoot until scored, then carry two balls, then crab walk 5 m and sprint.
coaching_points: Run through the line; hand-offs clean; cheer teammates.
harder: Penalty lap for a lost ball; add a defender at the finish.

name: Medicine Ball Partner Throws
description: Partners 3 m apart: chest pass, overhead throw, rotational throw each side, squat and throw, chest pass on one leg.
coaching_points: Power from the legs and hips; catch with soft arms; reset the stance.
harder: Increase the distance; add a jump before the throw.

name: Acceleration Starts
description: Starts from different positions to a 10 m sprint: standing, athletic stance, lying on the belly, kneeling, facing backwards on a call.
coaching_points: Push the ground; low body angle on the first 3 steps; drive the arms.
harder: React to a ball drop or a pass instead of a whistle.

name: Hopscotch and Skipping Patterns
description: Hopscotch squares; skipping A-skips; galloping lead with each leg; side skips; then combine two patterns.
coaching_points: Bounce off the toes; opposite arm-leg coordination.
harder: Hopscotch while dribbling a ball.

name: Change of Direction Shuttle
description: 5-10-5 shuttle: start in the middle, sprint 5 m right and touch, 10 m left and touch, 5 m back through the middle. Two rounds each, then the same with a dribble.
coaching_points: Plant the outside foot; low centre of mass; look where you go.
harder: Race a partner; add a coach cue mid-run.

name: Partner Reaction Chase
description: Pairs face each other 1 m apart on a line. One moves sideways (leader), the other mirrors. On the whistle both sprint to the baseline; the follower tries to tag the leader before the line.
coaching_points: Explosive first step; stay low; do not anticipate.
harder: Leader may fake the start.

name: Throw-Catch Coordination Wall Drill
description: Facing a wall 2 m away: chest pass and catch, one-hand right, one-hand left, clap between, turn 180 and catch, overhead and catch low; count reps in 30s.
coaching_points: Ready hands; eyes on the ball; fingers spread.
harder: Two balls alternating.

name: Tag Games (Chain Tag)
description: Chain tag: two taggers hold hands, every tagged player joins the chain; the chain must stay linked; last free player wins. Then freeze tag and doctor tag variations.
coaching_points: Use the whole space; change of pace and direction to escape.
harder: Everyone dribbles a ball while being chased.

name: Stationary Ball Handling Series
description: 30s each: pound dribble right, left, crossovers low, between the legs, behind the back, figure eight, spider dribble, scissors. Older groups add two-ball series.
coaching_points: Fingertips; eyes up looking at the coach; dribble below the knee on the crossover.
easier: Slow tempo; skip behind the back and spider.
harder: Two balls; eyes closed; add a call-and-respond with numbers.

name: Cone Dribble Moves Progression
description: Lines of 3 cones. At each cone do the move called: crossover, in-and-out, between the legs, behind the back, hesitation, spin. Attack the basket after the last cone for a lay-up.
coaching_points: Sell the move with the eyes and shoulders; explode after the move; finish strong.
easier: Only crossover and in-and-out; no shot.
harder: Combine two moves at each cone; coach becomes a live defender at the last cone.

name: Dribble Knockout
description: Everyone dribbles in a marked area; players try to knock other balls away while protecting their own. Lose the ball and you dribble 20 crossovers outside before re-entering. Shrink the area every minute.
coaching_points: Head up; low stance; protect with the off arm and the body.
easier: No knocking out; just avoid contact.
harder: Weak hand only; two balls each.

name: Full-Court Dribble Waves
description: Waves of 4 full court: speed dribble, then change of pace at each line, then crossover at each line, then retreat dribble and attack, then weak hand only.
coaching_points: Push the ball ahead to speed dribble; change pace sharply; stay low when retreating.
harder: Add a chasing defender one step behind.

name: 1v1 Dribble Tag in the Lane
description: Pairs in the paint or a 3x3 m square. Offence dribbles and tries to touch the defender with the free hand while keeping the dribble; defender avoids and tries to poke the ball. 30s bouts.
coaching_points: Keep the dribble alive; use the body to shield; quick hands on defence.
harder: Both players have a ball and try to tag each other.

name: Partner Mirror Dribble
description: Pairs face each other on a line; the leader dribbles and performs moves (crossover, between the legs, spin, low dribble, high dribble), the partner mirrors while dribbling. Switch on the whistle.
coaching_points: Eyes on the partner not the ball; react quickly; keep the rhythm.
harder: Leader moves sideways and forward; follower must stay in front.

name: Chair Dribble Attack
description: Chair at the elbow. Player dribbles at the chair, executes a move (crossover, hesitation, in-and-out) and finishes: lay-up, then pull-up, then floater. Both sides.
coaching_points: Attack the chair at speed; make the move one step before; finish with the correct foot.
easier: Cone instead of chair; only lay-ups.
harder: Coach at the chair as a live defender; add a helping defender on the second move.

name: Two-Ball Dribbling
description: Stationary: same time, alternating, one high one low, one crossover one pound. Then walking, then jogging full court, then with a cone change of direction.
coaching_points: Pound both balls hard; eyes up; rhythm consistent.
harder: Add a partner calling a hand to switch the pattern.

name: Dribble Relay Obstacle Course
description: Course around the gym: dribble around cones, through a hoop, over a line with a jump stop, around a chair with a spin, finish with a lay-up. Teams race, one at a time.
coaching_points: Control the ball first; lost ball means go back to the last cone.
harder: Time each team; weak hand only.

name: Change of Pace Lanes
description: Lane of cones every 4 m. Between cones alternate slow-slow-fast, then hesitation dribble at each cone, then stutter step and go.
coaching_points: Sell the slow with the shoulders and eyes; explode from a low position.
harder: Defender alongside who must stay level.

name: Protect the Ball 1v1 Square
description: 3x3 m square. Offence keeps the dribble alive for 20s while the defender tries to steal (no reaching across the body). Count seconds survived. Switch.
coaching_points: Body between ball and defender; low and wide; change hands only when protected.
harder: Two defenders; 1v1 to a cone.

name: Dribble Hand-Signal Drill
description: Players dribble facing the coach; the coach shows a number of fingers, players shout it; then the coach points a direction and players move that way; then the coach shows a move to copy.
coaching_points: Eyes forward always; peripheral vision on the ball.
harder: Two balls; coach shows two signals in sequence.

name: Lay-Up Dribble Finishes
description: From the wing, dribble to the basket and finish: strong hand lay-up, weak hand lay-up, reverse lay-up, jump stop and power lay-up, Euro step for older groups. Rebound and switch side.
coaching_points: Long last two steps; eyes on the target square; use the backboard.
easier: Start from the free-throw line, walking.
harder: Add a trailing defender or a coach with a pad bumping.

name: Retreat Dribble and Attack
description: Dribble at a cone (trap), retreat dribble two steps keeping the ball on the outside hand, crossover and attack the next cone. Then live with a defender jumping at the ball.
coaching_points: Retreat low and fast; ball on the hip away from the defender; attack immediately after.
harder: Two defenders trapping.

name: Dribble Rhythm to Music or Count
description: Coach counts or claps a rhythm; players match the dribble to the rhythm: slow, fast, two fast one slow, cross on the clap.
coaching_points: Listen; fingertips; keep the head up.
harder: Two balls with different rhythms in each hand.

name: Full-Court 1v1 Dribble Pressure
description: Offence must bring the ball full court against a live defender within 8 seconds and finish with a lay-up. Defender tries to turn the dribbler at least twice. Switch.
coaching_points: Change of pace; protect the ball; get the ball across half court quickly.
easier: Defender plays half speed; half court only.
harder: Two defenders trapping at half court.

name: Dribble Moves Mirror Shadow
description: Offence dribbles sideways along a line with moves; defender shadows without stealing, staying in front. Switch after 30s.
coaching_points: Offence: use the dribble to move the defender; defence: slide, stay low.
harder: Defender may steal; offence scores on reaching the sideline.

name: Dribble and Pass Combination Lanes
description: Two lines: player dribbles to a cone, makes a move, passes to the partner cutting, receives back and finishes. Rotate. Vary the pass (bounce, chest, one hand).
coaching_points: Pass off the dribble without picking the ball up; lead the cutter.
harder: Add a defender on the passer.

name: Speed Dribble Race
description: Full court race: speed dribble strong hand, back weak hand. Then race with a crossover at each line. Loser of each pair does 5 crossovers.
coaching_points: Push the ball out ahead; few dribbles; eyes on the far basket.
harder: Race with two balls.

name: Dribble Around the Body Chair Circuit
description: Stations: dribble around a chair keeping the ball low, figure-8 around two chairs, spin move at a chair, hesitation at a chair. 60s per station.
coaching_points: Low dribble; body between the chair and the ball; quick feet.
harder: Time limit per station with count of successful moves.

name: Escape Dribble Under Pressure
description: Offence at the free-throw line with a live defender; must dribble out of a 4 m zone within 4 seconds using an escape move (cross, spin, behind the back). Then finish 1v1.
coaching_points: Read the defender's lead foot; use the move to create space; go.
harder: Two defenders; must escape and pass to a teammate.

name: Weak Hand Only Practice
description: 5 minutes only with the weak hand: pounds, walking, jogging, change of direction with the weak hand, weak hand lay-up.
coaching_points: Keep the strong hand behind the back; fingertips; be patient.
harder: Add a defender.

name: Chest and Bounce Pass Fundamentals
description: Pairs 3-4 m apart: chest pass, bounce pass, overhead pass, 10 each; then step to the pass; then pass and cut to a cone; then the partner moves and you pass to the moving target.
coaching_points: Thumbs down and out; step into the pass; target hands ready; bounce pass lands two thirds of the way.
harder: One-hand push passes; passing off the dribble.

name: Star Passing
description: Five lines in a star; pass to the second line clockwise and follow the pass; add a second ball; add a lay-up at the end.
coaching_points: Call the name of the receiver; pass and go; ready hands.
harder: Three balls; alternate pass types.

name: Pass and Cut Three Man Weave
description: Three-player weave full court finishing with a lay-up; return with a two-on-one against the shooter as defender.
coaching_points: Pass ahead of the runner; sprint behind the receiver; communicate.
harder: Weave with two balls; 3v2 back.

name: Lay-Up Lines Both Sides
description: Two lines at the wings: shooting line and rebounding line. Dribble in for a lay-up; rebounder passes to the next. Switch sides every 2 minutes; count team makes.
coaching_points: Take off from the inside foot; high knee; aim for the top corner of the square.
easier: Start closer; no dribble, one step.
harder: Reverse lay-ups; add a defender chasing.

name: Form Shooting Progression
description: Close to the basket: one-hand shooting form, then two hands, then from 5 spots around the key at short range; make 5 from each. Older players: add a step back.
coaching_points: Elbow under the ball; wrist snap; hold the follow-through; feet shoulder width and toes to the basket.
easier: Shoot to a partner instead of the basket to focus on form.
harder: Shoot from the elbows; hold the follow-through until the ball hits.

name: Spot Shooting with Partner Passes
description: Pairs: shooter moves between 3 spots, passer rebounds and passes on the move; shooter catches, squares and shoots. 10 shots then switch. Score makes.
coaching_points: Catch with feet ready (hop or 1-2 step); square shoulders; shoot on balance.
harder: Add a closeout defender; shot fake and one dribble.

name: Two-Line Passing Full Court
description: Pairs run full court exchanging passes, no dribble allowed; finish with a lay-up. Vary: chest, bounce, one-hand, no-look, pass ahead.
coaching_points: Lead the runner; catch in stride; call for the ball.
harder: Add a defender in the middle trying to intercept.

name: Monkey in the Middle 3v1
description: Three passers in a triangle, one defender in the middle. Passers may move one step to create angles; the defender tries to touch the ball; 5 clean passes is a point. Rotate defender on a deflection.
coaching_points: Fake a pass to make a pass; pass away from the defender's hands; move without the ball.
harder: Two defenders; passers may not dribble.

name: Free Throw Routine and Pressure
description: Each player shoots free throws in pairs; build a routine (bounce, breathe, shoot). Then pressure: the team must make a target number in a row or runs a lap.
coaching_points: Same routine every time; legs power the shot; eyes on the front of the rim.
harder: Shoot one after a sprint; team consequences.

name: Give and Go Finishes
description: Wing passes to the coach or partner at the top, cuts hard to the basket, receives a return pass and finishes. Then from both wings; then with a fake before the cut.
coaching_points: Change of pace on the cut; show target hands; finish with the outside hand.
harder: Add a defender on the cutter.

name: Shooting Off the Dribble
description: From the wing: one dribble pull-up, two dribble pull-up, crossover pull-up. Both sides. Track makes in 2 minutes per spot.
coaching_points: Last dribble hard into the shot; feet under; shoot on the way up.
easier: Shoot from close range, one dribble only.
harder: Live defender closing out.

name: Passing Under Pressure 2v2 Keep-Away
description: Half court: 2 attackers try to complete 8 passes without dribbling against 2 defenders; a steal or a deflection swaps roles.
coaching_points: Fake, pass, move; meet the pass; cut to space.
harder: 1 dribble allowed max; time limit 15s.

name: Layup Variations Circuit
description: Stations around the basket: reverse lay-up, inside-hand finish, jump stop power lay-up, floater from the elbow, Euro step. 90s per station, rotate.
coaching_points: Footwork first; protect the ball; use the rim as a shield on reverses.
harder: Coach with a pad providing contact.

name: Partner Shooting Competition
description: Pairs alternate shots from a spot; first pair to 10 makes wins and moves to a harder spot. Rebounder passes to the shooter.
coaching_points: Quick set; same rhythm; encourage the partner.
harder: Add a closeout from the passer.

name: Outlet and Fill Passing
description: Rebounder grabs the ball off the board, pivots and throws an outlet pass to a wing at the free-throw line extended; wing passes ahead to a sprinting teammate for a lay-up. Rotate roles.
coaching_points: Chin the ball, pivot outside, strong two-hand overhead pass; wing calls outlet.
harder: Add a defender pressuring the rebounder.

name: One-Hand Push Pass Off the Dribble
description: Dribble to a cone and deliver a one-hand push pass to a partner without picking up the dribble; right and left hands; then to a cutting partner.
coaching_points: Pass from the dribble hand; wrist snap; keep the eyes on the target.
easier: Pick up the ball then pass.
harder: Defender on the passer.

name: Hot Shot Shooting Game
description: Individual: 60 seconds to score as many points as possible from marked spots (lay-up 1, short 2, elbow 3). Rebound your own miss. Record the score for next time.
coaching_points: Shoot quickly but in balance; always finish the lay-up.
harder: Must alternate sides after each shot.

name: Cutting and Catching (V-Cut and L-Cut)
description: Wing player makes a V-cut against a passive defender, receives on the wing and shoots or drives. Then L-cut from the block to the wing. Both sides.
coaching_points: Change of speed and direction; show the target hand; catch with feet ready.
harder: Live defender denying the catch.

name: Pressure Shooting Relay
description: Teams of 3 at one basket: player shoots, rebounds, passes to the next, sprints to touch the sideline and back in line. First team to 15 makes.
coaching_points: Shoot when tired with the same form; communicate.
harder: Longer sprint; score only counts from beyond the key.

name: Passing Against Pressure Triangle
description: Triangle of 3 passers with a defender on the ball at all times; the passer must pivot, protect and pass away from pressure. 20 passes without a turnover.
coaching_points: Pivot to protect; fake high pass low; use the body.
harder: Two defenders; no pivot allowed.

name: Baseline Drive and Kick
description: Wing drives baseline against a cone or passive defender, jump stops and kicks out to the opposite wing or corner for a shot. Rotate positions.
coaching_points: Drive to score; eyes up on the jump stop; receiver ready.
harder: Live help defender; read whether to finish or kick.

name: Rapid Fire Around the Key
description: Groups of 3 at a basket: shooter takes shots from 5 spots around the key while 2 rebounders feed continuously; 5 shots per spot then rotate.
coaching_points: Get set before the catch; quick release; same routine.
harder: Add a hop into the shot; count makes in 60s.

name: Shooting Around the World
description: Classic: make a shot from each of 7 spots in order; miss and you stay or risk going back to start. First around the world wins.
coaching_points: Focus; short-range shots must be automatic.
harder: Add a time limit per shot.

name: Bounce Pass Through the Gate
description: Pairs with a gate of two cones between them; bounce passes must go through the gate; then chest passes over a cone; then moving gates.
coaching_points: Aim two-thirds of the way; step to the target.
harder: Narrower gate; passing off the dribble.

name: Defensive Stance and Slides
description: Teach stance: feet wide, hips low, hands active. Slides baseline to sideline, then zig-zag slides full court with a drop step at each cone, then closeouts on the coach's call.
coaching_points: Never cross the feet; push off the back foot; head steady.
harder: Add a ball handler to shadow.

name: Zig-Zag 1v1 Full Court
description: Offence dribbles a zig-zag full court, defender slides and turns the dribbler at each line; live at the end for a 1v1 finish.
coaching_points: Stay a half step ahead; turn the dribbler; contest without fouling.
harder: Defender can steal; offence has a time limit.

name: Closeout Drill
description: Defender under the basket passes to a shooter at the wing and closes out: short choppy steps, hand up on the shot. Then closeout and contain a drive. Rotate.
coaching_points: Sprint then chop the feet; high hand; stay balanced.
harder: Shooter can shoot or drive either way; defender must contest and contain.

name: Shell Drill 4v4 Positions
description: 4 offence around the perimeter passing, 4 defenders adjust: ball pressure, one pass away denial, help side. Freeze on the whistle and check positions. Then allow drives.
coaching_points: Jump to the ball on every pass; see the ball and your player; talk.
harder: Live drives and skip passes; then full 4v4.

name: 1v1 from the Wing
description: Offence receives on the wing, live 1v1 with a limit of 3 dribbles. Defender tries to force the weak hand. Winner stays. Both sides.
coaching_points: Defence: nose on the ball, force the weak hand; offence: attack the front foot.
easier: Defender starts with hands behind the back.
harder: 1v1 with a help defender rotating in.

name: Deny and Recover
description: Defender denies the wing catch against a cutter with a hand in the passing lane; passer at the top; if the catch happens, recover to a closeout stance.
coaching_points: Ear on the chest of the passer; hand in the lane; see both.
harder: Live 1v1 after the catch.

name: Rebounding Box-Out Drill
description: Pairs around the key; coach shoots; defenders find their player, hit and box out, then pursue the ball. Rotate offence and defence.
coaching_points: Contact first, then find the ball; wide base; grab with two hands and chin it.
harder: 3v3 rebounding with an outlet pass to complete.

name: 2v2 Help and Recover
description: Two attackers on the wings, two defenders; ball is driven middle, the help defender stops the drive and recovers on the pass. Live to a score or a stop.
coaching_points: Help early, recover on the pass; talk 'help' and 'ball'.
harder: Add a third attacker in the corner.

name: Defensive Slide Relay
description: Teams: slide from cone to cone in a zig-zag, sprint back, tag the next player. Penalty for crossing the feet.
coaching_points: Low hips; hands out; quick recovery.
harder: Slide while dribbling.

name: 3v3 Half Court Continuous
description: 3v3 half court; defence must get a stop to go on offence; new team enters after every score. Rules: no more than 2 dribbles per touch.
coaching_points: Communicate on every pass; box out on every shot; sprint back on defence.
harder: Shot clock 12 seconds; only lay-ups score.

name: Wall Sit and Stance Holds
description: Stance holds 30s, wall sit 30s, slide 3 steps and hold, mirror the coach's hand movements while in stance.
coaching_points: Chest up; weight on the balls of the feet.
harder: Hold while a partner passes a ball around you to touch.

name: Take the Charge and Contest Drill
description: Defender slides to the spot and establishes position as the offence drives at half speed; then contest a shot with a vertical jump without fouling.
coaching_points: Feet set before contact; arms straight up; absorb.
harder: Live 1v1 from the top.

name: Steal the Bacon
description: Two teams on opposite sidelines numbered. Coach rolls a ball to the middle and calls a number; both players sprint, the first to get it attacks the basket 1v1 against the other.
coaching_points: First step; secure the ball with two hands; defend with the body.
easier: Coach places the ball, no roll.
harder: Call two numbers for 2v2.

name: 1v1 Full Court Transition Defence
description: Offence starts at the baseline, defender at the free-throw line; offence tries to score full court, defender sprints back to stop the ball and contain.
coaching_points: Sprint to the level of the ball; turn the dribbler; contest.
easier: Defender starts level with the offence.
harder: 2v1 back.

name: Defensive Communication 3v3 Calls
description: 3v3 half court; every defender must call ball, deny, or help aloud on each pass; a silent possession is a point for the offence.
coaching_points: Loud and early; the caller owns the position.
harder: Add screens and require calling the screen.

name: Loose Ball Dives and Recovery
description: Coach rolls a ball; player dives or sprints to secure it, gets up and passes to the coach; then two players compete for the ball.
coaching_points: Go hard but safe; secure with two hands; get up fast.
harder: Secure and finish a lay-up against a defender.

name: 2v1 Defence in the Paint
description: One defender against two attackers coming from the wings; defender must fake and delay, forcing a bad pass or contesting the finish.
coaching_points: Stay in the middle; fake at the ball; contest the lay-up.
easier: Attackers must pass at least twice.

name: Sideline Slide and Sprint Circuit
description: Slide sideline to sideline, sprint baseline to half court, backpedal back, slide again. 3 rounds with 30s rest.
coaching_points: Stance on the slide; stay low on the transitions.
harder: Add a ball pick-up at each transition.

name: Post Defence Basics
description: Defender on a post player; practise fronting, three-quarter denial, and playing behind; passer feeds from the wing.
coaching_points: Active arm bar; feet moving with the post; box out on the shot.
harder: Live 1v1 in the post.

name: Trap and Rotate 2v2 Sideline
description: Two defenders trap the ball handler on the sideline; two attackers try to escape with a pass; rotate defenders on each pass.
coaching_points: Trap with hands high, feet together; no reaching; rotate on the flight of the ball.
harder: 3v3 press with a rotating third defender.

name: Spacing Concepts 5-Out
description: Five spots around the perimeter marked with cones. Pass and cut, fill the empty spot, drive and kick; no defenders first, then 5v5 with 2 passes minimum.
coaching_points: Spacing 4-5 metres; fill the spot after a cut; eyes on the driver.
harder: Live 5v5 with a shot clock.

name: 2v1 Fast Break
description: Two attackers versus one defender from half court; the defender starts a step ahead. Score or stop; rotate.
coaching_points: Attack with the dribble until the defender commits; pass early to the open teammate.
harder: Trailing defender enters after 2 seconds.

name: 3v2 to 2v1 Continuous
description: Three attack two defenders one way; the two defenders then attack the other way against the shooter, becoming a 2v1. Continuous.
coaching_points: Middle player dribbles to the free-throw line and stops; wings run wide to the blocks.
harder: Add a trailer for 3v3.

name: Transition Sprint Lanes
description: Five players: rebounder outlets, wings sprint the sidelines, point receives at the wing, ball goes ahead for a lay-up; back the other way. Emphasise lanes and speed.
coaching_points: Wings run wide and deep; ball moves ahead by pass not dribble.
harder: Add 2 defenders getting back.

name: Pass and Cut Game 3v3 No Dribble
description: 3v3 half court, no dribbling allowed; players must pass and cut or replace. Score on a lay-up only.
coaching_points: Cut hard to the basket after every pass; replace the cutter.
harder: Add a screen away option.

name: Give and Go / Backdoor Reads
description: Wing and top: pass, cut for the return pass; if denied, backdoor cut. Defender plays passive then live.
coaching_points: Read the defender's position; cut behind if overplayed; passer reads the cut.
harder: Live 2v2 reads.

name: Press Break Basics
description: Inbound against two defenders on the ball; use a short cut and a middle flash; ball must cross half court in 8 seconds. Add defenders progressively.
coaching_points: Meet the pass; middle is open; no dribbling in the corner.
harder: Full court 5v5 press.

name: Small-Sided 2v2 Half Court
description: 2v2 half court, make it take it; must pass at least once before a shot. Emphasise spacing and give and go.
coaching_points: Space the floor; cut when your partner drives; talk on defence.
easier: Defence hands behind the back for 3 seconds.
harder: Only lay-ups count; 10 second shot clock.

name: Screen and Roll Introduction
description: Pairs: ball screen on the wing; ball handler comes off shoulder to shoulder; screener rolls or pops. Add a defender on the ball.
coaching_points: Screener wide base, arms in; handler reads the defence; roller shows hands.
harder: Live 2v2 with help defence.

name: Zone Offence Basics: Gap Attack
description: Against a 2-3 zone shell: attack the gaps with the dribble, pass into the high post, skip pass. 5 players on offence, 5 on defence in the zone.
coaching_points: Attack gaps to draw two; move the ball quickly; look inside first.
harder: Live 5v5 with shot clock.

name: Numbers Advantage Game (3v2 to 5v4)
description: Coach calls a number; that many players attack against one fewer defender from half court. Score in 10 seconds or turnover.
coaching_points: Find the open player quickly; defenders protect the basket first.
harder: Even numbers.

name: Read the Defender: Drive or Pass
description: Ball handler at the top, teammate on the wing, one defender who chooses to guard the handler or the wing; the handler reads and drives or passes.
coaching_points: Eyes on the defender; decide with the first step.
harder: Two defenders, three attackers.

name: Baseline Inbound Plays
description: Teach one simple inbound set: box or stack; practise walk-through, then live against defence.
coaching_points: Inbounder reads; screens set legally; second option ready.
harder: Live 5v5 with a counter.

name: Full Court 3v3 Transition Game
description: 3v3 full court; after a score the defence inbounds and attacks fast. Points doubled for a lay-up within 6 seconds.
coaching_points: Sprint on the change of possession; outlet quickly; fill the lanes.
harder: Add a fourth trailer.

name: Cutting Off the Ball 4v4 No Dribble
description: 4v4 half court, no dribbling; players must use V-cuts, backdoors and screens away to get open. Score only after 4 passes.
coaching_points: Move on every pass; screen and cut; passers fake.
harder: Add 2 dribbles allowed after the 4th pass.

name: Zone Defence Shell 2-3 Basics
description: Teach the 2-3 zone positions; offence passes around, defenders shift together on each pass; freeze and check; then live.
coaching_points: Move on the flight of the ball; hands up; talk.
harder: Live offence attacking gaps.

name: Knockout
description: Line at the free throw line (or closer for U9). First two players have balls; make before the player behind you or you are out; rebound and pass to the next.
coaching_points: Quick lay-ups after a miss; stay calm.
harder: Spot moves back after each round.

name: Dribble Tag Full Court
description: All players dribble in the half court; 2 taggers with balls try to tag others while dribbling; tagged become taggers. Last one free wins.
coaching_points: Eyes up; protect the ball; change speed.
harder: Weak hand only.

name: Scramble 3v3 Numbers Game
description: Three teams of 3 at one basket; winner stays, new team on defence must sprint in as the ball is inbounded. First team to 5 baskets.
coaching_points: Get organised fast; talk; box out.
harder: Losers do 5 push-ups.

name: Around the World Team Relay
description: Teams of 3-4: each team must make a shot from 5 spots, one player at a time; first team around wins.
coaching_points: Rebound your own miss; quick release; cheer.
harder: Must make 2 per spot.

name: King of the Court 1v1
description: 1v1 half court, winner stays on as king; limit of 3 dribbles; challengers line up. Rotate baskets for more players.
coaching_points: Attack the front foot; defence forces the weak hand.
harder: 1 dribble only.

name: Sharks and Minnows Dribble
description: Minnows dribble from baseline to baseline; sharks in the middle try to knock the ball away or tag; caught minnows become sharks.
coaching_points: Head up; change direction; protect the ball.
harder: Weak hand only.

name: Four Corners Passing Race
description: Two teams each in a square of 4 cones; pass around the square; first team to 20 passes wins; drop a pass and restart.
coaching_points: Sharp passes; ready hands; call the name.
harder: Two balls in each square.

name: Capture the Ball
description: Two teams, two half courts; balls in each team's zone; players sprint to steal balls from the other zone and dribble them back; tagged in enemy territory means a return to base.
coaching_points: Sprint and decelerate safely; dribble with control when carrying.
harder: Only weak hand dribbling.

name: Ultimate Basketball
description: Full court, no dribbling, no travelling; score by completing a pass to a teammate in the key or a lay-up. Turnover on a dropped pass.
coaching_points: Move to space; pass ahead; talk.
harder: Only bounce passes allowed.

name: Hunger Games Rebounding
description: Coach shoots; 3 players fight for the rebound; the one who secures it attacks 1v2 to score; others box out and defend.
coaching_points: Pursue the ball with two hands; go up strong.
harder: Must score within 5 seconds.

name: Team Free Throw Challenge
description: Team must make a target of free throws consecutively (e.g. 5); a miss resets. Each miss adds a sprint at the end.
coaching_points: Routine; breathe; support teammates.
harder: Every player must make one in a row.

name: Musical Chairs Dribbling
description: Players dribble around a circle of cones (one fewer than players); on the whistle they sprint to a cone with the ball; the player without a cone does 5 crossovers and rejoins.
coaching_points: Eyes up; control the stop.
harder: Two balls each.

name: Cool-Down Stretch and Reflection
description: Light jog, then static stretches: calves, hamstrings, quads, hip flexors, shoulders, 20s each. Circle: each player names one thing they did well and one to improve.
coaching_points: Slow breathing; no bouncing in the stretch; positive words.
harder: Add a foam roller station.

name: Partner Stretch and Team Talk
description: Partners assist stretches: hamstring, hip, shoulder; then the coach reviews the practice theme and asks two questions about what was learned.
coaching_points: Communicate the stretch intensity; listen.
harder: Add breathing exercise 2 minutes.

name: Free Throws and Cool-Down
description: Two free throws each in pairs while heart rate settles, then stretch circle.
coaching_points: Same routine every shot.
harder: Make one to leave.

name: Cool-Down Yoga Flow
description: Simple flow: child pose, cat-cow, downward dog, low lunge each side, pigeon each side, seated twist, lying breathing.
coaching_points: Slow; hold 20-30s; breathe.
harder: Hold 45s.

name: Walk and Talk Cool-Down
description: Walk two laps together with a partner discussing the best moment of practice, then a short group stretch.
coaching_points: Encourage everyone to speak.
harder: Each pair shares one thing with the group.

name: Balance and Breathing Cool-Down
description: Single-leg balance 30s each side with slow breathing; then lie down, 2 minutes of belly breathing; then stretch calves and hips.
coaching_points: Calm; eyes on a point.
harder: Eyes closed.

name: Pass and Cut Motion 3v0 to 3v3
description: Three players around the arc. Pass, basket cut, fill the empty spot; 5 passes then a lay-up. Progress to 3v3 with passive then live defence, scoring only after a cut.
coaching_points: Cut hard and to the rim; replace the cutter; catch ready to shoot or drive.
harder: Live 3v3, shot clock 10 seconds.

name: Drive and Kick Reads 2v2
description: Wing drives the gap; the other attacker relocates (fill behind or slide to the corner). Driver reads: finish, kick to the relocated teammate, or reset. Defence passive then live.
coaching_points: Drive to score first; eyes up on the jump stop; relocate away from the drive.
easier: No defence; coach calls the read.
harder: Live 2v2 with a help defender.

name: Give and Go / Backdoor Half Court 2v2
description: Top and wing. Pass, cut to the rim for the return; if the defender denies the return pass, backdoor cut. Rotate roles; both sides.
coaching_points: Read the defender before cutting; show a target hand; passer fakes before the pass.
easier: Defence with hands behind the back.
harder: Live 2v2, must score off a cut.

name: Dribble Hand-Off and Attack 2v2
description: Wing dribbles at the top player and hands off; the receiver attacks downhill, the passer rolls or spaces to the corner. Then live 2v2.
coaching_points: Hand-off shoulder to shoulder; receiver attacks immediately; passer protects the hand-off with the body.
harder: Defence may switch; read the switch.

name: Screen Away and Curl 3v3
description: Ball at the wing; opposite wing screens away for the corner player who curls, flares or cuts back based on the defender. Passer reads and delivers. Live 3v3 after 5 reps.
coaching_points: Screener: wide base, hold; cutter: wait for the screen, read the defender; passer: pass to the read.
harder: Screener slips when the defence jumps early.

name: Post Entry and Cut Through 3v3
description: Wing feeds the post; passer cuts through to the opposite corner, top player fills the wing. Post scores or kicks out. Live against 3 defenders.
coaching_points: Post: seal and show a target; passer: feed away from the defender then cut hard; spacing after the entry.
harder: Post must make a decision within 2 seconds.

name: 5-Out Spacing Game (Pass, Cut, Fill)
description: Five spots on the arc. Rules: pass and basket-cut, everyone fills one spot over; drive on a catch if the lane is open. 5v5 with defence passive, then live with a 3-pass minimum.
coaching_points: Space 4-5 metres; fill immediately; drive only against a closeout.
harder: Live 5v5, points doubled for a lay-up off a cut.

name: Pick and Roll Reads 2v2 to 3v3
description: Ball screen on the wing; handler reads under/over, screener rolls or pops; add a third attacker in the corner for the kick-out read. Defence progressively live.
coaching_points: Handler waits for the screen, two dribbles off it, eyes on the help; screener rolls to the rim with hands ready.
easier: No defence, coach calls the coverage.
harder: Defence varies coverage each rep.

name: Closeout Attack 1v1 from a Pass
description: Defender starts under the basket, passes to the attacker on the wing and closes out. Attacker reads the closeout: shoot, straight drive, or one-dribble pull-up. 3 dribbles max.
coaching_points: Catch ready; read the defender's feet; attack the front foot in one move.
easier: Defender closes out slowly with hands down.
harder: Add a help defender; must finish in 4 seconds.

name: Outlet and Fill the Lanes 5v0
description: Coach shoots; rebounder outlets to the wing, point receives in the middle, wings sprint wide to the corners, trailer to the top. Finish with a lay-up or kick-out; come back the other way. Waves of 5.
coaching_points: Outlet with a two-hand overhead pass; wings run wide and deep; ball in the middle by the free-throw line.
harder: Two defenders sprint back.

name: 2v1 Transition Continuous
description: Two attackers vs one defender full court; the defender and the shooter then attack the other way against a new defender. Continuous, groups rotate quickly.
coaching_points: Attack the defender with the dribble, pass when she commits; wing runs wide and finishes with the outside hand.
harder: Trailing defender enters after 2 seconds.

name: 3v2 Transition to Secondary Break
description: Three attack two defenders; if no lay-up in 5 seconds, flow into the secondary break: ball reversal, corner fill, trailer to the top. Then 2v1 back.
coaching_points: Middle player stops at the free-throw line; wings to the blocks then corners; keep the ball moving if the first look is closed.
harder: Add a trailer for 4v3.

name: Advantage Transition Game (3v2, 4v3, 5v4)
description: Coach calls a number; that many attackers go full court against one fewer defender, must score in 8 seconds. Defence then attacks the other way with a new number.
coaching_points: Find the open teammate early; attack with the ball in the middle; sprint on the change of possession.
easier: 10 seconds, no defence for the first 3 seconds.
harder: Even numbers on the return.

name: Rebound-Outlet-Go 3v3 Full Court
description: 3v3 full court; every possession starts with a rebound or a made basket followed by a quick outlet. Points doubled for a score within 6 seconds.
coaching_points: Outlet before the defence recovers; run wide; the trailer is the second option.
easier: Half court 3v3 with an outlet to the coach.
harder: Add a fourth trailer.

name: Pitch Ahead Full Court Passing
description: Three lines: rebounder, wing, sprinter. Rebounder outlets to the wing, wing pitches the ball ahead to the sprinter for a lay-up; rotate lines. Both sides.
coaching_points: Pass ahead of the runner; catch in stride, no dribble if possible; finish strong.
harder: A defender chases the sprinter.

name: Early Offense Flow into Half Court
description: 5v5 from a coach's miss: run the break; if nothing in the first 7 seconds, flow into the half-court spacing without stopping the ball. Coach freezes play to check spacing.
coaching_points: No pause between the break and the half-court offence; ball reversal; corners filled.
easier: Defence passive on the first possession.
harder: Shot clock 14 seconds.

name: 2v2 Continuous Rotation (mini basketball)
description: Three pairs at a basket: 2v2, winner stays, new pair enters on defence. Rules: at least one pass before a shot; only lay-ups score 2, others 1.
coaching_points: Pass and cut; talk on defence; hustle back.
harder: Score only after a give-and-go.

name: 3v3 Half Court with Rules
description: Three teams of 3 at a basket, winner stays. Rotating rule each round: no dribble; 3 passes minimum; score only off a cut; every player must touch the ball.
coaching_points: Coach only the rule of the round; let them play; box out every shot.
harder: 12-second shot clock.

name: 4v4 Half Court Constraint Game
description: 4v4 make-it-take-it at a basket; a third group of 4 rotates in on defence after each score. Constraints: a screen must be used before a shot; or drive-and-kick only.
coaching_points: Spacing 4 wide; screen and cut; help and recover.
harder: Points only from the paint or after a skip pass.

name: 4v4 Full Court Scrimmage
description: 4v4 full court with a rotating third team at half court waiting to enter on the change of possession. Transition scores count double.
coaching_points: Run wide; trailer to the top; sprint back on defence.
harder: Full-court press allowed.

name: 5v5 Half Court Live with Variations
description: 5v5 half court; defence gets the ball on a stop. Variations by round: 3 passes before a shot; must post up once; zone defence; 14-second shot clock.
coaching_points: Coach the theme of the day only; celebrate good decisions, not just baskets.
harder: Losing team runs the length.

name: 5v5 Full Court Scrimmage with Constraints
description: Full-court scrimmage, 5-minute periods, with a constraint per period: transition only (score in 8 seconds); half-court only after a made basket; man defence, no help.
coaching_points: Let it flow; stop only for teaching moments about the theme of the day.
harder: Live free throws and fouls.

name: 3v3 to 5v5 Progressive Scrimmage
description: Start 3v3 at a basket; after each score the scoring team adds a player from the sideline until 5v5; then reset. Variations: no dribble at 3v3, screens mandatory at 5v5.
coaching_points: Spacing changes with numbers: notice it and talk about it.
harder: Shot clock shortens as numbers grow.
